These are exact historical generated IR and texture receipts from commit
`0b63d7c0f46d7f620415de718537e5864ef36540`, retained as test inputs before
admitting the extended catalog. `source.json` records each original path,
snapshot hash and actual historical binary hash. Readers regenerate the old
pack with the original format and compare its complete byte hash.

These inputs are not current release authority or played game saves. They
preserve independent old resource-reader tests after production resources
advance. The unchanged upstream content retains its original permission;
see the repository's third-party notices. No font/tool executable is included.
